company.name: Emi Labs
company.shortDescription: Increasing Frontline Workers’ access to professional opportunities
company.description:
At Emi we are on a mission to increase Frontline Workers’ access to professional opportunities. This is a population that accounts for +70% of the world’s workforce. They are digitally invisible, as there’s little to no data available on who they are, their career history, or their skill set, limiting their access to professional opportunities and growth. We're here to transform this by building the infrastructure to make Frontline Workers visible.
 
Our first step to achieving our mission is to transform the recruiting experience into an easy, human and fair process, for both candidates and companies with high-volume job openings. Emi, our main product, is an A.I. recruitment assistant that enables companies to engage in a conversation with each applicant to detect interested and qualified individuals while saving Recruiters a huge amount of time by automating tasks such as screening, validating skills, scheduling interviews, and collecting documents.

We operate with a remote-first culture with office hubs in Buenos Aires, Mexico City, and San Francisco.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $11,000,000, or 84.62% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,882,083 to $59,620,943, a 15.36x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
